components.label: variant_option_values
components.sublabel: Connects a variant to its choices
components.tag: One value per option per variant

components.label: inventory
components.tag: At most one inventory row per variant

cards.title: categories
items: PK id uuid; name varchar(100); UNIQUE slug varchar(100); created_at timestamptz.
Name is nonempty; slug uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

cards.title: products
items: PK id uuid; FK category_id uuid; UNIQUE slug varchar(160); name varchar(160); description varchar(5000).
status: draft / active / archived. specifications jsonb defaults to {} and must be an object. created_at and updated_at timestamptz.
No color, size, price or stock fields live here. Every product references one existing category.

cards.title: product_options
items: PK id uuid; FK product_id uuid; name text; position integer; created_at and updated_at timestamptz.
Option names are unique per product after trimming whitespace and lowercasing. Nonempty names: 1-100 characters.
Positions are nonnegative and unique per product (deferred constraint). Example: Color, Size, RAM.

cards.title: product_variants
items: PK id uuid; FK product_id uuid; UNIQUE sku varchar(100); price_minor integer; currency text; active boolean.
combination_key text is generated by database triggers from sorted selected value UUIDs. UNIQUE(product_id, combination_key), deferred.
Prices are nonnegative integer ore; currency must be SEK. created_at and updated_at timestamptz. A simple product uses one default variant; legacy zero-variant rows remain possible.

cards.title: product_option_values
items: PK id uuid; product_id uuid; option_id uuid; value text; position integer.
Composite FK(product_id, option_id) references product_options(product_id, id).
Labels are nonempty (1-100 characters) and unique per option ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Positions are nonnegative and unique per option. Example: Red, Blue, EU 42.

cards.title: variant_option_values
items: product_id uuid; variant_id uuid; option_id uuid; option_value_id uuid. All columns are required.
Composite PK(variant_id, option_id) prevents two values from the same option on one variant.
Composite FK(product_id, variant_id) references product_variants(product_id, id). Composite FK(product_id, option_id, option_value_id) references product_option_values(product_id, option_id, id).
Deferred triggers require every variant to select exactly one value for every product option. No duplicate combinations. All selected values must belong to the same product.

cards.title: inventory
items: PK / FK variant_id uuid references product_variants(id). quantity integer defaults to 0 and must be nonnegative. updated_at timestamptz.
A missing inventory row is treated as zero stock by catalog reads. Exact quantities stay private; public responses contain inStock.

cards.title: product_images
items: PK id uuid; FK product_id uuid; nullable variant_id uuid; storage_key varchar(255); alt_text varchar(300).
width and height integer (1-10000); nonnegative position integer, unique per product; created_at timestamptz.
Composite FK(product_id, variant_id) references product_variants(product_id, id), so variant images cannot point to another product. NULL variant_id means a shared image.
Storage keys must match products/<lowercase-name>.jpg, .webp or .png. Alt text is required and nonempty.

cards.title: How to read the relationships
items: Each arrow points from parent to child; labels describe parent : child cardinality. A shared image has no variant parent; a variant image has exactly one.
The ownership columns in composite foreign keys deliberately repeat product_id to prevent cross-product references.
PK = primary key. FK = foreign key. UNIQUE = duplicate values rejected. All options are required; not all theoretical combinations need a variant.

cards.title: Red + EU 42 example (illustrative)
items: products P1 = Everyday sneaker. product_options O1 = Color and O2 = Size.
product_option_values RED belongs to O1 and S42 belongs to O2.
product_variants V1 = SKU SHOE-RED-42, price_minor 44900. variant_option_values contains (P1,V1,O1,RED) and (P1,V1,O2,S42).
inventory contains (V1,8). Selecting RED and S42 resolves V1; its price is SEK 449.00 and it is in stock.

cards.title: Integrity and deletion
items: The complete graph is validated at transaction commit. Temporary intermediate states are allowed inside a save, but an incomplete final graph rolls back.

Product deletion cascades to owned options, variants and images. Variant deletion cascades to stock and selection rows. A referenced option value or variant image reference must be reconciled before deletion.
Triggers serialize graph writes on the parent product and update its edit version. Bounds: 8 options, 100 values per option, 250 variants, 50 images.

cards.title: Source and scope
items: Based on current local backend/migrations/002_catalog.sql and 003_dynamic_options.sql, plus catalog read behavior in product.repository.js.
Current schema after migration 003: color and size columns are removed. Identity fields are UUIDs; example IDs are abbreviated.
Local workspace has no Git metadata: this is an inspected working-file diagram, not a commit-pinned repository evidence receipt. Authentication tables are outside this product-focused view.
